messages:
Ana: Quick oncall kit sanity sweep before tonight's rotation — tagging the oncall crew. Please reply with ✅/❌ and any short notes. Items:
- VPN access + config checked
- PagerDuty mobile push + escalation routing verified
- Runbook link reachable and the 'recover-primary' play tested in dry-run
- Service account keys / SSH creds not expired
- Ops tooling (kubectl, rds-cli) auth works from jump host
- Any outstanding deployment flags or capacity risks

Sam: ✅ VPN ok from home. Tested with `openvpn --config /opt/reds/vpn.ovpn` and got IP 10.12.5.22. No MFA prompts (cached).

Jordan: Runbook link is up: https://confluence.redwood.com/oncall/runbooks/recover-primary. Did a dry-run of the DB failover steps up to step 3 (no actual failover) — notes in the page. One FYI: the monitoring svc account key `monitor-ingest-prod` is scheduled to rotate tomorrow; I raised a ticket to rotate earlier if we need it during the night.

Maria: PagerDuty mobile push verified and escalation path set to `ops-sre-escalations` -> Sam if I don't ack in 5m. Also confirmed Slack @oncall notifications are enabled for the PD channel.

devops-bot: Automated check: kubectl auth test passed from jump-host-1. rds-cli token refresh successful. No blocked deploys.

Ana: Thanks — two quick follow-ups:
1) Jordan — can you move the rotation window for `monitor-ingest-prod` to 08:00 UTC tomorrow instead of 00:00? If not, note it in the runbook as a known risk.
2) Sam — can you add the `--no-cache` flag to the VPN command in the quickstart so new rotators don't hit stale creds?

Sam: Will update quickstart now, pushing a tiny PR.

Jordan: I can't move the rotation (org policy), but I added an explicit note in the runbook and a rollback snippet:
```
# If monitoring ingest fails after rotation
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/ingest || echo "manual intervention required"
```

Maria: Noted. I'll stay on standby during the window and will escalate immediately if alerts spike. :thumbsup:

Ana: Great. Last ask — anyone who can't confirm by 19:00 UTC, please DM me ASAP so I can reassign. Otherwise I'll post the handoff summary at 19:15 with pager assignment and links. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Reminder scheduled: PagerDuty on-call handoff in 45 minutes for rotation starting 19:30 UTC.

Sam: ✅ all set from my side. Good to hand off.
